discussion.title: RFC: Keyboard-only triage flow for the inbox
discussion.bodyHTML:
Power users have been asking for a way to triage without ever leaving the keyboard. I'd like to lock down the shortcut surface before we ship v0.5.

Proposed bindings:

  • j / k — move selection
  • e — archive
  • s — snooze (opens picker)
  • t — convert to task
  • ? — show shortcut overlay

Open questions: do we model snooze with relative durations only (1h, 4h, tomorrow) or also let users pick a date? And should e follow Gmail (archive) or Linear (delete)? Vote in comments 👇

answer.bodyHTML:
After reading the thread I think we should:

  1. Match Gmail's e for archive (people switching from Gmail will thank us).
  2. Offer both relative durations and a date picker, defaulting to the relative menu.
  3. Keep ? as the global shortcut help overlay.

Happy to draft the spec PR if there are no objections by Friday.
